arguments.description: measure visible block and pad surfaces
arguments.python:
from kinex import device, profile, call
import numpy as np
from scipy.spatial.transform import Rotation
for cam in ['head_camera','left_camera','right_camera']:
 d=device(cam); c=np.asarray(d['color']); raw=np.asarray(d['depth']); p=profile(cam)['intrinsics']; print(cam,c.shape,raw.shape)
 # color-registered optical Z in profile units
 z=raw*p['depth']['scale_m_per_unit']; v,u=np.indices(z.shape); k=p['color']['projection']; pts=np.stack(((u-k['cx'])*z/k['fx'],(v-k['cy'])*z/k['fy'],z),-1)
 tf=call('relative_pose',child={'frame':cam},parent={'frame':'world'})['pose']; pts=Rotation.from_quat(tf[3:]).apply(pts.reshape(-1,3)).reshape(pts.shape)+tf[:3]
 for label,m in [('red',(c[:,:,0]>150)&(c[:,:,1]<90)&(c[:,:,2]<90)),('blue',(c[:,:,2]>140)&(c[:,:,0]<90)&(c[:,:,1]<100)),('table',(c.min(axis=2)>190))]:
  m=m&(raw>0)
  a=pts[m]
  if len(a): print(label,len(a),'bounds',np.min(a,0),np.max(a,0),'median',np.median(a,0),'percentiles',np.percentile(a,[5,95],axis=0))

arguments.description: finish right approach using measured arrival feedback
arguments.python:
from kinex import device,call,finish
for x in [0,-.025,-.048]:
 s=device('right_arm'); assert not s['faults']
 p=call('relative_pose',child={'frame':'world','pose':[x+.12,.052,.975,0,0,1,0]},parent={'frame':'right_arm'})['pose']
 js=device('right_arm','ik',{'pose':p,'seed':s['positions']})['joints']
 call('servo',device='right_arm',joints=js,speedFraction=.4,block=False)
 stable=0;last=-1
 for i in range(400):
  s=device('right_arm');assert not s['faults']
  if s['timestamp']>last:
   stable=stable+1 if max(abs(a-b) for a,b in zip(js,s['positions']))<.01 and max(abs(v) for v in s['velocities'])<.01 else 0
   last=s['timestamp']
  if stable>=3: break
 else: raise RuntimeError('right approach did not settle')
 print('arrived',x,s['timestamp'])
print(call('relative_pose',child={'frame':'right_gripper:tcp'},parent={'frame':'world'}))
x=device('head_camera',args={'output':'file'});finish({},file=x['file'])
